sections.label: THINKING
sections.content:
Interesting! Clicking on (55, 8) moved the purple square BACK from (56-58, 5-7) to (54-56, 7-9). And importantly:
- (55, 8) is NO LONGER in the path pixels list
- (57, 6) is BACK in the path pixels list
So the pattern is:
1. Clicking a path pixel moves the purple square to that position
2. The clicked path pixel gets "collected" (disappears)
3. The PREVIOUS position of the purple square becomes a path pixel again
This is like the purple square is "eating" path pixels as it moves! Each time it moves, it consumes the pixel it moves to, and the pixel it leaves behind is restored.
So the goal might be to collect ALL path pixels by moving the purple square along the entire path. The purple square needs to visit every path pixel to collect it.
Current path pixels: 20 pixels from (17, 46) to (53, 10), plus (57, 6)
Purple square is at (54-56, 7-9), which corresponds to the (55, 8) position.
To collect all path pixels, I need to move the purple square along the entire path, visiting each pixel. The path goes:
(57, 6) <- (55, 8) <- (53, 10) <- (51, 12) <- ... <- (17, 46)
Currently the purple square is at (55, 8) position. The remaining path pixels are:
(57, 6), (53, 10), (51, 12), ..., (17, 46)
If I click on (53, 10), the purple square will move there and collect it. Then I can continue clicking on (51, 12), (49, 14), etc. until I reach (17, 46).
But wait, (57, 6) is also a path pixel. If I click on it, the purple square would move there and collect it. But then I'd need to come back to collect the others.
Actually, let me think about this more carefully. The purple square is at (55, 8). The path pixels adjacent to it are (53, 10) and (57, 6). If I click on (53, 10), the purple square moves there and collects it. Then I can continue to (51, 12), (49, 14), etc.
But what about (57, 6)? If I go to (53, 10) first, then (57, 6) is still a path pixel but the purple square is now at (53, 10), which is not adjacent to (57, 6). Can I still click on (57, 6) to move the purple square there?
Let me try clicking on (53, 10) to continue collecting path pixels toward the blob end.
